other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Punjab
Applicant must be a Building/Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker)
Applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must have a monthly income of ₹15,000 or below
Applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund
Applicant must not be a member of EPF, NPS, or ESIC
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Beneficiary must have been registered with the Board for at least 6 months prior to the child's birth
Beneficiary must have regularly deposited his contribution
Scheme applies up to two living children
benefits_summary: Female workers receive ₹21,000 per child (maximum two children); male workers receive ₹5,000 per child for their spouse’s children (maximum two children).
